You are an expert Roblox game developer and game designer.

Create a complete, professional Roblox game called "MonsterVerse."

GAME GENRE
- Open-world monster collecting adventure
- Exploration RPG
- Mobile and PC optimized
- Bright, colorful low-poly Roblox style
- Smooth performance (60 FPS target)
- Beginner-friendly progression
- Highly expandable for future updates

==================================================
CORE GAMEPLAY LOOP
==================================================

Spawn
↓

Explore the world

↓

Find wild monsters

↓

Catch monsters

↓

Gain coins and XP

↓

Upgrade equipment

↓

Unlock new areas

↓

Discover rarer monsters

↓

Complete monster collection

↓

Become the strongest trainer

==================================================
WORLD 1
==================================================

Create a beautiful forest world approximately 250x250 studs.

Include:

• Spawn Village
• Shop
• Quest NPC
• Monster Research Lab
• Slime Meadow
• Dense Forest
• Flower Field
• River
• Pond
• Waterfall
• Wooden Bridge
• Cave Entrance
• Ancient Tree
• Small Hills
• Dirt Paths
• Cliffs around map edges

The map should feel alive and encourage exploration.

==================================================

Every monster should:

Look around

All AI should use reusable state machines.

==================================================

==================================================
CODE QUALITY
==================================================

Use ModuleScripts.

Separate client and server logic.

Use RemoteEvents and RemoteFunctions securely.

Write clean, well-commented, modular Lua code.

Organize folders professionally.

Avoid duplicated code.

==================================================
FUTURE EXPANSION
==================================================

Design every system to support:

100+ monsters

20+ worlds

Trading

Evolution

Bosses

Raids

PvP

==================================================
FINAL GOAL
==================================================

Build a polished, expandable Roblox game that feels like a premium monster-collecting adventure with smooth gameplay, professional UI, reusable systems, optimized performance, and a strong foundation for long-term updates.

image_prompt.text: A Spawn Village free of wild monsters where players start, restock and turn in quests
Shop, Quest NPC and Monster Research Lab clustered tightly together so collectors are not walking between them
Open clearings holding wild monster spawns - a Slime Meadow and a Dense Forest - set back from the dirt paths
Visible blockades on the routes to later ground, so new areas read as unlocked rather than simply distant
An Ancient Tree standing above the canopy so players can orient themselves across the world
A river crossing the map with a pond and a cascading waterfall
A wooden bridge spanning the river
Winding dirt paths linking the village to each biome
A flower field and small rolling hills as scenic ground between the monster clearings
A cave entrance set into the forest
Cliffs ringing the map edges to contain the playable area

layout_placement.text: Points inside each meadow and forest clearing where wild monsters emerge and respawn after being caught

notes: The world is specified as approximately 250x250 studs, which is smaller than the sixteen named locations comfortably fit; the pipeline should expect a dense map rather than a sparse open world.
Whether the Shop, Lab and Cave Entrance are entered or interacted with from outside is unstated. Left outside-only, so no P3 was added - if any of them is enterable this becomes a P3 build.
Turn-based RPG is the monster-collecting preset; combat here is a catch prompt rather than turns, but the layout job is the same single-map town-and-overworld.

open_questions.ask: Are the Shop, Monster Research Lab and Cave actually entered, or interacted with from outside? Interiors change the build route.

theme: Stylized / Toon - low-poly, bright colours, rounded edges, soft lighting

coverage_missing.ask: Which of the named buildings are enterable?
250x250 studs is tight for sixteen locations - is the number firm or approximate?
Do the later worlds share this map or are they separate places reached by teleport?

answers.ask: Are the Shop, Monster Research Lab and Cave actually entered, or interacted with from outside? Interiors change the build route.
answers.answer: Use simple enterable interiors for the Shop and Monster Research Lab, and make the Cave a short accessible cave area entered through its entrance.
